policy_note: Measured by scripts/covgate (larql-cli-coverage.yml): whole crate, no exclusions, test code removed from the denominator (dep-info for test-only files, ast-grep for cfg(test) items), decided per cell (target triple x feature set). GATING rules have no free parameter: every required cell reports (cells), a line two targets both compile has one verdict (spread, census data), no stale debt (stale), nothing may leave scope, gain debt or lose a threshold against the base branch (ratchet), and no new test may check nothing (assert-lint, run by `covgate lint`). The line-percentage rules (file, total, functions, trait, diff) are REPORTED: 90 is a placeholder until it is derived from the replay experiment's measurements (detection probability D, scripts/covgate/decision). The previous policy gated five subtrees with a 7% crate floor; this one measures everything and gates what can be decided without choosing a number.
